temperature_2m.verdict: Air temperature at 2 m increased by about 0.15 °C per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.015): it is unlikely to be just chance.

precipitation.verdict: Precipitation increased by about 0.028 mm/day per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.0035): it is very unlikely to be just chance.

relative_humidity_2m.verdict: Relative humidity at 2 m increased by about 0.91 % per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.0021): it is very unlikely to be just chance.

specific_humidity_2m.verdict: Specific humidity at 2 m increased by about 0.29 g/kg per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p < 0.001): it is very unlikely to be just chance.

wind_speed_10m.verdict: Wind speed at 10 m decreased by about 0.043 m/s per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p < 0.001): it is very unlikely to be just chance.

solar_radiation.verdict: Solar radiation at the surface decreased by about 0.032 kWh/m²/day per decade (1984–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p < 0.001): it is very unlikely to be just chance.

evapotranspiration.verdict: Evapotranspiration increased by about 0.057 mm/day per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.013): it is unlikely to be just chance.

soil_wetness_root.verdict: Root zone soil wetness increased by about 0.0042 fraction 0–1 per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.0058): it is very unlikely to be just chance.
